name: Saimin Kazoku ~Yadokari~
source:
Saimin Kazoku ~Yadokari~ follows a seemingly ordinary newlywed couple whose peaceful life is invaded by an outsider who takes over their home and family from the inside.

Rokugou Tatsuhi and his wife Sayaka met in university, dated for years, and married shortly after graduating. Tatsuhi works hard to support them, and although his job keeps him busy, the couple is happy in their new life together. That happiness begins to unravel after a company drinking party, where a drunken Tatsuhi is approached by a man named Inagi Koremasa.

Koremasa is a man who lives as he pleases, using hypnosis to prey on others. When he grows bored of his current living situation, he simply finds a new household to move into. After hearing about a beautiful housewife, he deliberately targets the Rokugou couple. He takes the intoxicated Tatsuhi home and, upon meeting Sayaka, decides their house will be his next residence.

From that moment, Koremasa begins to work his way into their lives—manipulating their hearts, taking over their bodies, and turning their home into his own. The couple continues to go through the motions of family life, but the person living among them is no longer who he appears to be. Like a hermit crab, Koremasa has moved into someone else’s shell and claimed it as his own.
